meta.source: usevantagepoint.com homepage (logo file and computed styles), read 2026-11-15, plus the brand assessment agreed the same day

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Core. Sampled from the logo. Headlines, brand fills, primary buttons. White text on it is 13.3:1. Replaces the site's #0E2F59 and black buttons.

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Core. Sampled from the logo. Rules, rings, icon accents, and text or buttons on brand-navy (5.7:1). Never text on white or sand: 2.3:1 fails.

tokens.name: brand-sky-deep
tokens.usage: New. Sky darkened for text. Links and small labels on white (5.2:1), sand and sky tint (4.7:1). White text on it is 5.2:1.

tokens.name: brand-sky-tint
tokens.usage: New. Panels, table bands, chart fills. Ink text 13.8:1, navy text 12.1:1.

tokens.name: brand-amber
tokens.usage: New hue, the only warm color. One highlight per view: the Donate button or a single key number. Navy text on it is 6.6:1. Never white text (2.0:1). Keep under 10% of any layout.

tokens.name: neutral-white
tokens.usage: Default page and card background.

tokens.name: neutral-sand
tokens.usage: New. Warm alternate section background in place of gray. Ink text 13.8:1, slate text 6.4:1.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: New. Body text. Navy-biased near-black replacing the site's #1B1B1B. 15.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: neutral-slate
tokens.usage: New. Secondary text and captions, replacing the site's #5E5E5E. 7.0:1 on white, 6.4:1 on sand and sky tint.

tokens.name: neutral-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls on white (4.4:1, clears the 3:1 minimum for control edges).

tokens.name: neutral-line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines only. 1.4:1 on white, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: bg-page
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating section background.

tokens.name: bg-tint
tokens.usage: Highlighted panel background.

tokens.name: bg-brand
tokens.usage: Brand sections: headers, footers, stat bands, title slides.

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Headings on bg-page, bg-alt and bg-tint.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body text on bg-page, bg-alt and bg-tint.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions and secondary text on bg-page, bg-alt and bg-tint.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Links and uppercase labels on bg-page, bg-alt and bg-tint.

tokens.name: text-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on bg-brand. 13.3:1.

tokens.name: text-on-brand-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg-brand. 10.5:1.

tokens.name: text-on-brand-accent
tokens.usage: Labels, links and number accents on bg-brand. 5.7:1.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on light backgrounds, with text-on-brand.

tokens.name: action-on-brand
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on bg-brand, with brand-navy text (5.7:1).

tokens.name: action-give
tokens.usage: Donate and other giving actions only, with brand-navy text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline on light backgrounds (5.2:1). On bg-brand use neutral-white.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Form success text and icons on white (5.3:1). Utility color, not a brand color.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Form error text and icons on white (6.2:1). Utility color, not a brand color.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page. Title slide.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Numbers in the stat block. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Empowering people with disabilities by connecting their passions to meaningful, integrated employment.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline, in text-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We are a 501c3 nonprofit and an approved vendor of the California Department of Rehabilitation.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Average hourly wage of clients placed in 2025

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, navigation and button text. Always uppercase (set text-transform: uppercase). Carried over from the current site's navigation.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside a component.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to heading, button row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter, paragraph gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Brand panel padding, gap between a heading block and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Space between major page regions on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, stat bands.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Rectangular photographs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Ring-cropped photographs and the ring device.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Raised cards on bg-alt only. Cards on white use a neutral-line border and no shadow.
